packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once CI passes; major updates stay manual.
The Jellyfin packages set the Companion's minimum server version (targetAbi). Raise it by hand when a newer API is needed; only new major versions are proposed.
The .NET SDK in global.json stays on the .NET major Jellyfin runs on (10 for Jellyfin 12), so minor and patch 10.x updates come through but a new major does not.
Move all Jellyfin packages together so the plugin and its tests compile against one server version.

build-linux builds the Linux AppImage on the runner itself and stays on ubuntu-24.04 so its glibc baseline runs on Ubuntu 24.04 (distribution/libmpv/linux/README.md). Move the pinned ubuntu runner image by hand.
